description: Tool to list SKAdNetworkConversionValueSchema configurations for an iOS data stream. Use when you need to retrieve conversion value schemas for iOS app tracking. Maximum one schema per property is supported.

inputSchema.description: Request model for listing SKAdNetworkConversionValueSchema on a data stream.

pageSize.description: Optional. Maximum number of resources per response. Default: 50, Maximum: 200.
pageSize.title: Page Size

pageToken.description: Optional. Token from previous call for pagination to retrieve next page of results.
pageToken.title: Page Token

parent.description: Required. The DataStream resource to list schemas for. Format: properties/{property_id}/dataStreams/{dataStream}. Example: 'properties/123456789/dataStreams/1234567890'
parent.title: Parent

inputSchema.title: ListSKAdNetworkConversionValueSchemasRequest

name: list_sk_ad_network_conversion_value_schemas

ConversionValues.description: Defines a mapping from a set of conditions to a conversion value.

coarseValue.description: Coarse-grained value. Enum: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH.
coarseValue.title: Coarse Value

lockEnabled.description: Locks SDK to this value for current window when true.
lockEnabled.title: Lock Enabled

ConversionValues.title: ConversionValues

EventMapping.description: Defines conditions that must be met for a conversion value to be set.

eventName.description: Required. GA4 event name (max 40 UTF-16 code units).
eventName.title: Event Name

EventMapping.title: EventMapping

nextPageToken.description: Token for retrieving subsequent pages. Note: Currently never populated as only one schema is supported per dataStream.
nextPageToken.title: Next Page Token

skadnetworkConversionValueSchemas.description: Array containing SKAdNetworkConversionValueSchema objects. Note: This will have at most one value as Google Analytics supports only one schema per dataStream.
skadnetworkConversionValueSchemas.title: Skadnetwork Conversion Value Schemas

conversionValues.description: Prioritized list (max 128 entries); first matching entry selected.
conversionValues.title: Conversion Values

postbackWindowSettingsEnabled.description: Must be true for window one; determines if values apply.
postbackWindowSettingsEnabled.title: Postback Window Settings Enabled

applyConversionValues.description: When true, enables SDK conversion value setting and Ads export.
applyConversionValues.title: Apply Conversion Values

postbackWindowOne.description: Fine-grained conversion settings for first postback window.
postbackWindowOne.title: Postback Window One
